title: Rondò Veneziano
notes: Orchestral debut joining baroque forms with a contemporary rhythm section.

title: La Serenissima
notes: Chamber-like Venetian melodies; the title theme won over British listeners.

title: Scaramucce
notes: More classical writing with marked rhythms; national editions differ in sequence.

title: Venezia 2000
notes: Seamless anthology in two suites; number one in Switzerland.

title: Odissea veneziana
notes: Baroque themes meet expanded electronics; nine-track original includes the extended Tiziano suite.

title: Casanova
notes: Orchestral miniatures and keyboard textures; original Italian sequence differs from overseas Odissea edition.

title: Rapsodia veneziana
notes: Thirteen compact instrumental pieces; issued as Fantasia veneziana in Germany and Austria.

title: Arabesque
notes: Orchestral crossover with electronic keyboards; German Misteriosa Venezia reshuffles and extends the program.

title: Concerto
notes: Orchestral miniatures and classical guitar; Controdanze intertwines three dances across stereo channels.

title: Masquerade
notes: Compact baroque-flavoured instrumentals with acoustic-guitar detail and several distinct export sequences.

title: Barocco
notes: Orchestral Baroque-pop from documented digital sessions; international versions alter the original running order.

title: Prestige
notes: Final Baby Records studio set; title track suggests a sharper electronic-adjacent texture.

title: Stagioni di Venezia
notes: Venetian orchestral miniatures with twelve new compositions and two rerecorded early themes.

title: Il mago di Venezia
notes: Gentle yet dramatic orchestral pieces, with documented electric-guitar solos and Venetian imagery.

title: Sinfonia di Natale
notes: Instrumental Christmas repertoire, classical adaptations and new holiday suites, supported by programming.

title: Marco Polo
notes: Fifteen-part journey eastward, mixing orchestral storytelling with piano and programmed percussion.
